attributes.name: Scarf of Storytelling
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 2d6 to a Knowledge check by a character at your location.

Discard this card and name a card to examine the top 5 cards of any location deck. Set aside all cards with that name, then shuffle the deck and put the named cards on top.
